The '''''Eradicator''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that was a part of the [[Moff Sarne's forces|fleet]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] during his campaign. Its [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Thulian Merast]] and its [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]] was [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jav Remlyn]].
